summary: Open-source agent that runs ML training experiments in a loop, proposes code changes, keeps only improvements that beat the current best result. 630 lines, runs 700 experiments in 2 days autonomously.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — focused on ML training optimization loops, not code orchestration. The keep-only-improvements pattern is interesting but AgentForge's skill distillation already captures successful task patterns. No direct gap.

summary: LangGraph standardizes on checkpointer-based short-term (thread-scoped) + store-scoped long-term memory. BufferMemory deprecated. 60%+ of production agent incidents trace to state management failures.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — AgentForge already has skill distillation (distillationAgent.ts, agentSkillRepository.ts) for cross-run procedural memory. Cross-run episodic memory is already tracked by HID-188.

source: SICA — Self-Improving Coding Agent (Robeyns et al., ICLR 2025 Workshop)
summary: Agents that autonomously edit their own prompts and tools based on execution feedback, climbing from 17% to 53% on SWE-Bench Verified without human intervention.
relevanceToAgentForge: Medium — directly relevant to the skill distillation gap (executor prompts don't receive skills yet). However HID-188 tracks memory injection into executor. Self-editing prompts would be a larger architectural change than 1-2 agent runs. Backlog also full (11 open issues).

summary: Unified SDK merging Semantic Kernel enterprise features with AutoGen multi-agent orchestration into a single production SDK for .NET and Python.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — full framework not a pattern. AgentForge is a bespoke CLI-subprocess orchestrator; adopting MS Agent Framework would be a full rewrite.

summary: CrewAI 1.14 (April 2026) introduced pluggable memory/knowledge/RAG backends. Enterprise tier launched March 2026 with observability and scheduling.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — AgentForge uses its own AgentSkillRepository for skill memory. Pluggable RAG backends are out of scope; no new infrastructure (per design constraints).

source: Prime Agent — RL-based self-improving coding agent (Prime Intellect, Aug 2026)
summary: Open-source RL-based coding and research agent from Prime Intellect with 6.6k GitHub stars, v0.7.1. Treats its own operating environment as something the agent can inspect and gradually improve via reinforcement signals.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — RL training loops are explicitly in the red-flag list (Phase 3 selection rules). Requires training infrastructure not in AgentForge's stack.

summary: Google ADK 2.0 shifted from hierarchical executor to graph-based execution engine, announced at Google I/O 2026.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — full framework architectural change. AgentForge's explicit state machine is a deliberate design choice, not a gap.

summary: Karpathy coined 'agentic engineering' (Feb 2026): orchestrating agents as oversight, not writing code directly. Joined Anthropic May 2026 to use Claude to build next Claude.
relevanceToAgentForge: Low — conceptual framing, not a specific pattern to adopt. AgentForge already embodies this model.
